capabilities.description: Order coffee for pickup at Deckhouse Coffee, a small specialty roaster. A short, deliberate menu — House Blend whole bean and a Cold Brew Kit — that an agent can read, price, and buy. Ordering is a consequential action: it runs only after a human authorizes the exact terms (item and quantity) on the page, and a term changed after authorization is blocked. Demonstration shop; ordering places a mock order and takes no payment.
